requestBody.query: what's the difference between travel pass and roam better?

200.answer: A Travel Pass includes unlimited talk and text, plus data from your rate plan, and it takes priority over Roam Better when travelling in eligible destinations. If you do not have Roam Better, you'll be billed according to pay-per-use rates.

snippets.text: ## What to expect on your bill If you don't have a travel add-on (Roam Better or Travel Pass) * If you don’t have Roam Better – with home data or a Travel Pass, you'll be billed according to the pay-per-use rates applicable to your destination when you make or receive a call, send a text or use data. * To calculate your out-of-bundle usage, see the billing details provided on your bill. * Voice calls and data while roaming are reflected through the use of Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). UTC is the primary time standard by which the world regulates time. * Text messages sent while roaming are reflected through the use of Eastern Time ET. If you have Roam Better – with home data * For destinations not covered by Roam Better, you'll be billed according to the pay-per-use rates applicable to your destination when you make or receive a call, send a text or use data. Roam Better customers require a Data Travel Pass to use data in destinations not covered by Roam Better. * Voice calls and data while roaming are reflected through the use of Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). UTC is the primary time standard by which the world regulates time. * SMS while roaming are reflected through the use of Eastern Standard Time ET. If you have Roam Better – with home data Roam Better – with home data * The Roam Better – with home data feature includes unlimited talk and text in the U.S. (including Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands) and over 200 international destinations and back to Canada. Plus, use the data from your account while travelling. Available with most monthly plans and Small Business plans. * Beyond 5 GB, speeds are up to 512 Kbps for the rest of the day, suitable for light web browsing, email and messaging.† Data speeds reset at 12:00 a.m. ET daily. If you use up the data in your rate plan and want to continue using data, data overage charges of your plan will apply. * See the [Roam Better FAQ](http://www.bell.ca/travel)for rates and other details. Roam Bette
